subject: Marine Works - Douglas Channel & Gardner Canal - Kitimat Harbour
text:
Marine Works - Douglas Channel & Gardner Canal - Kitimat Harbour
Old wharf demolition at LNGC berth-1 Kitimat and construction of a new LNG berth-1 in the vicinity of 53 59.700N 128 40.840W. The pre-work involves pile extraction, heavy lift, dredging etc.
Hours of work 24 hrs a day from May 2026 to Feb 2030.
Work vessels monitoring VHF channel 7 and 16.
